name: Cross-venue signal: Polymarket -> Kalshi (politics/world)
window_binding_constraint: Polymarket CLOB /prices-history retains ~30 days; markets ending before ~2026-06-20 return an empty history array (verified 2026-07-26).

observation_filters.execution_price: kalshi ask for YES, 1-bid for NO (never the mid)

kill_reasons: Founding premise fails: on the matched politics universe Kalshi is the DEEPER venue (median Poly/Kalshi dollar volume 0.50; Poly deeper in only 32% of observations).
Polymarket is not the sharper reference: Brier 0.1445 vs Kalshi 0.1373; the Brier-minimising blend weight on Polymarket is 0.0 (monotone).
No money net of cost: net PnL +0.66c/ct at margin 0 with an event-clustered CI of [-6.94, +11.08], negative point estimate at every larger margin, and negative net CLV at 0/1/2c margins.
The lead-lag that survives on 5 clusters (beta +0.30) collapses to +0.045 [-0.039, +0.143] on the 15-cluster HIGH+MED universe.

notable_negative_result.h2_corridor_prior: NOT confirmed on politics. The ev-map H2 study found a fee-bounded +/-2c corridor in the liquid sports head. On matched politics markets the basis breaches the corridor 56% of the time (median |gap| 2.10c vs median corridor 1.98c, p90 6.00c). The corridor is not what stops this trade; the absence of information in the gap is.
notable_negative_result.implication: Any future Kalshi<->Polymarket work must not assume the basis is arbitraged flat outside sports.

monetisation_blocker: N/A for P-020 by construction — it executes on Kalshi only, so the Polymarket-execution blocker that shelved P-002/P-006 does not apply. The blocker here is that the signal does not exist.
do_not_retest_without: A politics/world universe where Polymarket is demonstrably the deeper book (e.g. a US general election cycle), measured dollar-for-dollar BEFORE any signal work.
A Polymarket price history longer than ~30 days (own capture, or a paid historical feed), so the sample is not 3 Trump-speech events plus 2 primaries.
